content.comment_body: Hello all, For several years, I've used multiple [product_name] modules along with a [product_name] gateway for sending and receiving text messages, which works well. My current question is: Is it possible to send commands in the form of URLs to any IP address? The intention is to trigger an action on a remote device, such as a network storage device or an IP camera. If this isn't possible with the current [company_name] setup, what hardware or software could be added to enable an output or variable from [product_name] to generate a URL and activate functionality on a remote device? Thanks in advance for any suggestions or ideas. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to enhance their current [product_name] setup to send commands as URLs to networked devices like NAS units or IP cameras. While they are satisfied with message functionality via their gateway and [product_name] module, they find that direct IP-based command triggering is not currently supported or straightforward with their existing infrastructure. They are looking for more advanced remote control options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to enable URL-based command transmission from their [product_name] system to other devices on the network, and is seeking advice or recommendations on hardware or software to implement this capability.
